# DEVSYNX

> DEVSYNX Private Limited is a software development company in Islamabad, Pakistan. It builds custom software, AI automation and AI agents, web and mobile apps, SaaS products and Shopify stores, and provides SEO and digital marketing, for clients in Pakistan, the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and the UAE.

Contact: info@devsynx.com, phone and WhatsApp +92 302 946 2542. Address: Islamabad, Pakistan. Founder and CEO: Syed Hassan Ali Shah. Clients served: 300+.

## Services
- [AI automation agency](https://devsynx.com/services/ai-automation/): engineered business process automation with LLMs, n8n and custom code
- [AI agent development](https://devsynx.com/services/voice-ai-bots/): custom voice, chat and workflow agents
- [Web development](https://devsynx.com/services/custom-web-development/): Next.js and React websites and web apps
- [Mobile app development](https://devsynx.com/services/mobile-app-development/): iOS and Android apps in Flutter and React Native
- [SaaS development](https://devsynx.com/services/saas-product-development/): multi-tenant SaaS from MVP to scale
- [Shopify development](https://devsynx.com/services/ecommerce-solutions/): custom themes, apps and headless stores
- [All services](https://devsynx.com/services/)
